title: Cab Readiness and Departure Checks
description: Practice neutral selection, door-closed confirmation and a cautious initial traction request.

steps.instruction: At standstill, locate the master controller and select N before a departure-readiness check.
Read the All Doors Closed indication. Explain why a door-close command alone is not enough.
With the door closure indication confirmed, request low power using P1 and observe the speedometer.

learningObjective: Describe the relationship between a cab readiness check, door status and the first power request.
operatingConditions: The simplified teaching cab does not implement full electrical startup, signaling authority or fleet-specific checks.
expectedObservations: All Doors Closed remains the required door-status confirmation.
P1 is a low power request and speed changes progressively after acceptance.
debriefQuestions: Why is selecting N not a complete train startup procedure?
Why must door closure be confirmed rather than inferred from a Close command?
